meals.note: Every meal is an army trio.

missables.text: Clear Bertrand's Paralogue by 9/25 even before Renown 9: Peppe can't be recruited without it
missables.lose: Peppe for good, plus 20,000G, 150 Renown and an Extra Large Bullion

missables.text: Clear Talimun's Paralogue 9/17 to 9/22, or in the backup window 10/1 to 10/10
missables.lose: The Cleansing Blade, 20,000G, 150 Renown and Ursula's recruit
detail: Deadline 10/12. Miss both windows and it's gone.

missables.text: Do Aurora's Special Request from Mom the day Renown 8 lands: Seteth and Nydine need Dragoon
missables.lose: Dragoon for Seteth (Ch 11 or 12) and Nydine (Part II Ch 2)
missables.recover: None: Renown doesn't carry into Part II

note.text: Buy 4 Advanced Licenses in Megaira (3 if you clear Giant's-Print Fort first); exam in ledger order
detail: This chapter: Tialla, Cai, Guzran, Ultand. Do Aurora's request first.
Seteth, Ninae, Sirocco (and maybe Fianna) follow in Ch 11 or 12: 3 to 4 more Licenses.

override.text: Black Magic not B yet after her missed Ch 9? Stay Shaman one more map

barter.for: Ultand: read it at once for Dark Spikes Τ
Sirocco: Death Γ; hold it until he joins, then read it at once

assign.why: Iapetus Cavern chest: read it at once for Banshee Θ
Ch 10 map, left side; his Vandahl Hammer goes to Jasmine
Ch 10 map, right side; hold it until he joins

note.text: Check Vandahl's dark-magic stock each visit: it seems to grow with Renown
Skipped Cai's Vandahl Levin Sword? The map's copy is Cai's; Sirocco then takes a Ch 10+ Nuzzuo's

recruits.action: Recruit her the day Renown 8 lands (the Thermae opening is your signal)
Pay 3,000G once both gates are met
detail: She takes the ninth slot until Sirocco joins; bring her on dungeon runs too.

recruits.action: Recruit him right after Bertrand's Paralogue, once Renown 9 lands
Finish his short quest (a copy of the Monument Verse?) to recruit him
detail: He takes the ninth slot from the next map as the main nuke; Ultand moves to support caster beside Noctula.

recruits.action: Hand over 3× [[item:Iron Bow]]: he brings a Levin Sword
Pay 5,000G: she brings a Mini Bow?
Clear Talimun's Paralogue, then answer Yes 3 times: she supports Jasmine, Fianna, Peter, Sirocco
Hand over 3× Glirmosa: he supports Cai, Peter, Guzran, Peppe, Sirocco and Mikaela

prep.text: Ch 10+ recruits join at about Lv 25 in a Specialty class: no Beginner exam
detail: One arrives in a class other than the plan's? Take that exam with a Specialty License.

prep.text: Io and Jester wait for Renown 10 (Ch 11)

route.note: Aurora, Renown 8: the unlock is Dragoon, plus 8,000G
Hand in the 30 crops you planted in Ch 8

sub.note: Hand over 2 of the Da Mina weapons you collected
Follows For the Empire's Safety; the other Ch 8 pick gives Assassination (No Questions)
Thermae bulletin at Renown 8 (first playthrough only)

paralogue.note: First, 9/17 to 9/25: kill 4 Giants before Peppe's group does
detail: Bait your target Giant to hold it for a turn.
The yellow units around a Giant vanish when it dies, so skip them.

paralogue.note: Second, 9/17 to 9/22: a thief with cargo runs for the top exit, so keep one unit back to intercept
Third, by 10/5 (opens 9/24): limited roster, so bring Tialla or Ninae plus an armor-killer
detail: Don't send Solel at the Giant.
Clear enemies and ore deposits first. The last deposit lowers the Giant's armor and stuns it: break it when ready.
Train on Ogmios: bring Seteth, Ninae, Fianna and Sirocco, the ones racing to Lv 35.

explore.text: [[place:Iapetus Cavern]] (Lv 32, Solidus): Archive θ for Ultand, Black-Magic Manual
detail: Manual: Ultand if she's still short of Black Magic B for Ovate, otherwise Sirocco.

explore.text: Gather 7 Glirmosa in Pasithea: 4 for Archive T, 3 for Mu
detail: Mount Orgus Trail, Rear Mountain Path, Forest of No Return, Giant's Mount; grab 4 on the Nemea Cavern trip.

explore.text: No Wild Pegasus yet? Catch one now for Flying Steed (Ch 11)

tips.text: Lure Theodora off her bonus tiles before you attack
Pick up both map items: each helps against armor
